item.title: ChatGPT and the ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR drama, fixed.
item.author: noreply@john-thebaptist.github.io (John)
item.description: A controlled investigation into ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR, broken HTTP/2 traffic and the Windows service responsible. Thirty days of ChatGPT freezes, failed replies and a broken desktop app, traced through browser, account and network tests to a single Intel Killer service.
